Remark
[Symmetric operators and eigenfunction bases] ↗ thm:hyperbolic-improved-regularity 1. ch7:7.2.3-rem-3\group Regularity

If $L$ is symmetric, the Galerkin basis may be chosen as an $H_0^1(U)$ eigenfunction basis of $L$, eliminating estimate (59).
